restaurant.name: KFC
restaurant.notes: Prices and availability may vary by location. All chicken is prepared with the Colonel's secret 11 herbs & spices. Available in Original Recipe or Extra Crispy.

items.name: KFC® 8 pc. Chicken & 2 Large Sides A La Carte
items.description: Eight pieces of KFC's world-famous fried chicken, prepared with their 11 herbs and spices, available in Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, offering a golden, crispy skin and tender, juicy meat. This generous meal is complemented by two large sides of your choice.

items.name: KFC® 12 pc. Chicken & 3 Large Sides A La Carte
items.description: Twelve pieces of KFC's legendary fried chicken, available in Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, delivering that distinct, savory taste with a perfectly crisp exterior and succulent interior. Served with three large sides of your preference, making it ideal for a family feast.

items.name: KFC® 16 pc. Chicken & 4 Large Sides A La Carte
items.description: Sixteen pieces of KFC's iconic fried chicken, choose between Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, each piece seasoned with the Colonel's secret 11 herbs and spices for an unforgettable flavor and satisfying crunch. This ultimate meal comes with four generous large sides.

items.name: KFC® 8 pc. Chicken Only

items.name: KFC® 12 pc. Chicken Only
items.description: Twelve pieces of KFC's world-famous fried chicken, offered in your choice of Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, delivering a satisfying crunch and tender, flavorful meat with every bite.

items.name: KFC® 16 pc. Chicken Only
items.description: Sixteen pieces of KFC's legendary fried chicken, choose between Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, providing a substantial and delicious offering of perfectly seasoned and cooked chicken.

items.name: KFC® 3 pc. Chicken Only
items.description: Three pieces of KFC's delicious fried chicken, available in Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, perfectly seasoned and cooked to a golden finish, offering a tender and juicy interior with that unmistakable KFC taste.

items.name: KFC® 4 pc. Chicken Only
items.description: Four pieces of KFC's famous fried chicken, choose between Original Recipe or Extra Crispy, each piece expertly prepared with the Colonel's 11 herbs and spices, ensuring a satisfyingly crunchy and flavorful experience.

items.name: 3 pc. Chicken Tenders Only
items.description: Three succulent, all-white meat crispy chicken tenders, expertly seasoned and fried to a golden perfection, offering a tender and juicy bite every time.

items.name: 5 pc. Chicken Tenders Only
items.description: Five succulent, all-white meat crispy chicken tenders, expertly seasoned and fried to a golden perfection, ideal for a satisfying meal or sharing.

items.name: 8 pc. Chicken Tenders Only
items.description: Eight succulent, all-white meat crispy chicken tenders, expertly seasoned and fried to a golden perfection, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

items.name: 12 pc. Chicken Nuggets Only
items.description: Twelve crispy, golden-brown chicken nuggets, made with 100% white meat chicken, seasoned and fried to a perfect crunch, ideal for dipping in your favorite sauce.

items.name: 36 pc. Chicken Nuggets Only
items.description: A generous serving of thirty-six crispy, golden-brown chicken nuggets, made with 100% white meat chicken, seasoned and fried to a perfect crunch, perfect for sharing or a party.

items.name: KFC® Classic Chicken Sandwich
items.description: A premium, juicy, extra crispy fried chicken fillet, perfectly seasoned and nestled in a toasted brioche bun with thick-cut pickles and the Colonel's rich, creamy mayonnaise.

items.name: KFC® Spicy Chicken Sandwich
items.description: For those who crave a kick, this sandwich features a juicy, extra crispy fried chicken fillet, seasoned with a bold spicy blend, served on a toasted brioche bun with crisp pickles and a fiery, creamy spicy mayonnaise.

items.name: KFC® Chicken Little® Sandwich
items.description: A delightful small sandwich featuring a crispy fried chicken tender, served on a soft bun with fresh pickles and a touch of creamy mayonnaise, perfect for a lighter bite.

items.name: KFC® 3 pc. Chicken Little® Sandwiches
items.description: A trio of our popular Chicken Little sandwiches, each with a crispy fried chicken tender, pickles, and mayo on a soft bun, ideal for sharing or a more substantial snack.

items.name: Secret Recipe Fries
items.description: Crispy, golden-brown French fries seasoned with KFC's unique blend of secret spices, offering a flavorful and satisfying crunch with every bite.

items.name: Mashed Potatoes & Gravy
items.description: Creamy, fluffy mashed potatoes made from real potatoes, smothered in KFC's rich, savory gravy, a classic comfort food side.

items.name: Coleslaw
items.description: Freshly prepared, crisp cabbage and carrots mixed in a tangy, sweet, and creamy dressing, offering a refreshing counterpoint to the fried chicken.

items.name: Sweet Kernel Corn
items.description: Deliciously sweet and tender whole kernel corn, steamed to perfection, providing a simple yet satisfying vegetable side.

items.name: Green Beans
items.description: Flavorful green beans cooked until tender-crisp, often seasoned with a hint of ham or other savory spices, a comforting Southern-style side.

items.name: Mac & Cheese
items.description: Creamy and rich macaroni pasta baked in a cheesy sauce, a decadent and satisfying side dish loved by all ages.

items.name: Biscuit
items.description: A fluffy, warm, and buttery buttermilk biscuit, freshly baked to a golden perfection, ideal for soaking up gravy or enjoying on its own.

items.name: 4 Biscuits
items.description: Four fluffy, warm, and buttery buttermilk biscuits, freshly baked to a golden perfection, perfect for sharing or a family meal.

items.name: 6 Biscuits
items.description: Six fluffy, warm, and buttery buttermilk biscuits, freshly baked to a golden perfection, a generous portion for larger gatherings.

items.name: 12 Biscuits
items.description: A dozen fluffy, warm, and buttery buttermilk biscuits, freshly baked to a golden perfection, ensuring everyone gets a taste of this Southern staple.

items.name: KFC® Famous Bowl®
items.description: A hearty and savory bowl layered with creamy mashed potatoes, sweet corn, bite-sized crispy fried chicken, savory gravy, and topped with a blend of three shredded cheeses.

items.name: KFC® Pot Pie
items.description: A comforting and rich individual chicken pot pie, filled with tender chicken pieces, diced potatoes, carrots, peas, and a savory sauce, all baked under a flaky golden crust.

items.name: KFC Sauce
items.description: KFC's signature sweet and tangy sauce, perfect for dipping chicken, tenders, or fries, adding a unique flavor dimension.

items.name: Honey BBQ Sauce
items.description: A classic barbecue sauce with a sweet honey glaze, offering a smoky and tangy flavor profile, ideal for pairing with chicken.

items.name: Honey Mustard Sauce
items.description: A delightful blend of sweet honey and tangy mustard, creating a creamy and versatile dipping sauce that complements chicken perfectly.

items.name: Creamy Buffalo Sauce
items.description: A rich and creamy sauce infused with the bold, spicy kick of traditional buffalo flavor, perfect for those who enjoy a bit of heat.

items.name: Ranch Sauce
items.description: A cool, creamy, and herbaceous ranch dressing, offering a refreshing and savory taste that pairs well with almost anything.

items.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie
items.description: A warm, soft, and chewy chocolate chip cookie, loaded with rich chocolate morsels, baked to golden perfection for a sweet treat.

items.name: 12 pc. Chocolate Chip Cookies
items.description: A dozen warm, soft, and chewy chocolate chip cookies, packed with generous chocolate chips, perfect for sharing or enjoying throughout the week.

items.name: Coca-Cola
items.description: The classic, refreshing taste of Coca-Cola, a crisp and effervescent soda that perfectly complements any meal.

items.name: Diet Coke
items.description: The crisp and sugar-free alternative to Coca-Cola, offering the same great taste without the calories.

items.name: Sprite
items.description: A refreshing, lemon-lime flavored soda with a clean and crisp taste, perfect for quenching your thirst.

items.name: Dr. Pepper
items.description: A unique blend of 23 flavors, Dr. Pepper offers a distinctive and refreshing soda experience.

items.name: Mountain Dew
items.description: A bold and energizing citrus-flavored soda with a sweet and tangy kick.

items.name: Sweet Tea
items.description: Classic Southern sweet tea, freshly brewed and perfectly sweetened for a refreshing and authentic taste.

items.name: Unsweetened Tea
items.description: Freshly brewed iced tea, unsweetened, offering a crisp and natural tea flavor.

items.name: Lemonade
items.description: Tart and sweet lemonade, a classic refreshing beverage perfect for any occasion.

items.name: Orange Juice
items.description: Refreshing and tangy orange juice, a perfect complement to breakfast or any meal.

items.name: Milk
items.description: Cold, wholesome milk, a classic beverage choice.

items.name: Bottled Water
items.description: Crisp and refreshing bottled water, perfect for staying hydrated.
